description: Somos un equipo multidisciplinario de jóvenes con interés en la ciencia, la tecnología, la programación y la exploración espacial. Nos une la curiosidad por comprender el universo y la determinación de convertir conocimientos e ideas en soluciones innovadoras.
summary: The LUNARIS experience will unfold through a system of exploration, construction, and resource management, with each mission presenting space engineering challenges rooted in real-world research and data from NASA. These include the 98% water recovery rate demonstrated on the International Space Station in 2023, oxygen-production technologies, and studies concerning energy, radiation, and lunar habitability. This information will serve as a foundation for designing simulations in which players must balance limited resources, maintain interdependent systems, and contend with the consequences of their decisions to ensure the survival of their crew.
details:
LUNARIS is an educational simulation and strategy video game based on NASA data, in which the player must build, manage, and maintain a habitable base on the Moon or Mars.

Unlike an experience focused solely on memorizing information, LUNARIS tasks students with taking control of a space mission and making decisions based on real-world engineering challenges.

Players must select a site, build infrastructure, manage limited resources, and respond to situations that threaten the safety of the crew. Their decisions will directly impact the operation of systems for water, oxygen, energy, protection, and food supply.

Every action carries a cost, a consequence, and a scientific explanation. If a strategy fails, the player can analyze what happened and seek a different solution. In LUNARIS, science ceases to be mere information to be memorized and instead becomes a tool for decision-making.
